data.narrative:
Distributed Spectrum is a Seed-stage Defense & Security company founded by Alex Wulff, Ben Harpe, and Isaac Struhl, having raised $25M to date. The valuation assessment draws from a comp universe of 10 private and 2 public peers in the defense technology sector, including UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Saronic.

Two valuation methods were applied. Stage-Progression analysis uses the $25M total raised as a proxy for current value and applies a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage advancement, yielding $62M. Peer-Median analysis examines three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables: UFORCE at $1.0B (Seed), Singularity at $400M (Series A), and NODA AI at $125M (Series A). The median across these three peers is $400M, with a range spanning $125M to $1.0B.

Triangulating these two methods produces a valuation range of $53M (low) to $460M (high), with a median of $231M. The substantial spread reflects material uncertainty regarding Distributed Spectrum's relative position within the defense tech landscape. Key uncertainties include product maturity relative to the peer set, revenue traction or pathway to commercialization, and customer acquisition status in the defense procurement environment. The Stage-Progression method anchors to capital deployed; the Peer-Median approach captures market sentiment for comparable technologies but relies on a limited sample of three peers.
